gen-gf-barlow-condensed-fs-literata: Barlow Condensed keeps its capitals drawn in lines of constant thickness, curves left open, while Literata brings a bookish serif. Plain unmodulated lines above, sturdy thin-and-thick strokes below, make the difference.
gen-gf-barlow-semi-condensed-fs-literata: Flat gray hum, constant line weight: that is Barlow Semi Condensed, every c wide like a pitcher. Literata shifts mildly from heavy stems to lighter curves; the heading earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-barriecito-bitter: Ladle-bowled and expressive: Barriecito stacks big-bodied lowercase against compact capitals, while Bitter, a slab-serif, shows a very large lowercase eye. Display flair on top, dependable and grounded beneath it.
gen-gf-barriecito-instrument-sans: Instrument Sans never changes its stroke weight, its c ends spread like open pincers, beneath the ladle-shaped bowls of Barriecito. Instrument Sans stays minimal where capitals meet lowercase, a quiet foil to the display heading's flourish.
gen-gf-barriecito-inter: Barriecito pours open bowls like a tipped ladle. Inter, a sans with big counters and a stout, tube-like line, can sit at modest size while the heading goes large.
gen-gf-barriecito-mulish: Mulish runs like neon tubing bent into letters, with horseshoe-open apertures and a large x-height, under the ladle-bowled display lowercase of Barriecito. A modern, approachable sans below, an expressive display face above.
gen-gf-barriecito-poppins: Poppins draws rope-loose curves with no thick-thin flicker, its lowercase tall and sturdy, beneath Barriecito and its ladle-open bowls. Paragraphs of it would glide along smoothly, modern and clean.
gen-gf-barriecito-roboto-slab: Tipped-ladle bowls up top, structured slabs below. Barriecito brings the display flair while Roboto Slab, a slab-serif with open throats, keeps the middle of each line dense and precise.
gen-gf-barriecito-rubik: Barriecito lets its open bowls tip forward like a ladle. Rubik, a soft, clean sans with round open letters, sits beside it like a quieter neighbor, easing off where the heading performs.
gen-gf-battambang-instrument-sans: Distinctive, Battambang squeezes its ascenders and opens every curve wide. Instrument Sans, whose strokes are never heavier on the downstrokes, can sit comfortably at a generous size without crowding.
